title: Learned addressing under predictable-key and structured-channel controls
question: Can a learned address scorer provide value beyond trivial exact-key matching, while remaining calibrated to the Bayes-optimal raw-dot baseline?
relation_to_prior: Supersedes learned-address v1 as the intended next test; v1 is retained as instrument-invalid and is not remeasured.

design.exact_key_condition: diagnostic only; raw dot and learned scorer are expected to saturate and this condition carries no capability claim.
design.isotropic_gaussian_condition: query = unit target key + sigma*epsilon with epsilon isotropic Gaussian. Raw dot is the registered Bayes reference.
design.structured_channel_condition: query = normalize(D*k + sigma*epsilon), where D=diag([2]*8+[0.5]*8) is fixed across training/evaluation and unknown to the raw-dot baseline. The learned query scorer is trained on this channel.
design.address_independence: address keys independent of payload and answer.
design.semantic_scope: opaque associative addressing only; no semantic/content-derived address inference.

required_controls: raw-dot Bayes reference on every corruption condition
decision_rule: Exact-key success does not license a learned-address claim.

On isotropic Gaussian corruption, learned addressing must be non-inferior to raw dot within 0.02 absolute accuracy; beating raw dot is not required and would not by itself be evidence of a better addressing rule.
On the registered structured diagonal channel, learned scoring must exceed raw dot by at least 0.05 mean accuracy over the predefined sigma grid at M=3.
Capacity curves at d=16 must be reported for M={3,8,16,32,64,128,256}; no M may be selected after inspection.
Failure of the learned scorer does not imply learned addressing impossibility.
hypothesis: A learned query/key scorer will match the raw-dot Bayes reference on isotropic Gaussian corruption and can exceed raw dot under the registered structured diagonal channel.

arms.name: learned_scorer
arms.intervention: learned shared query/key scoring model trained on registered channel conditions

arms.name: raw_dot
arms.intervention: argmax raw dot product over stored unit keys
